name: better-drizzle
description: Minimal, type-safe repository helpers for Drizzle ORM.

scripts.check: bun run check:types && bun run check:lint && bun run test && bun run pack
scripts.check:lint: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --check . '!**/*.{md,mdx}' && NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts .
scripts.fix: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts --fix . && NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --write . '!**/*.{md,mdx}'
scripts.bench:all: bun run benchmark/time.ts && bun run benchmark/full.ts && bun run benchmark/memory.ts
scripts.test: bun test tests/core tests/rules tests/eslint tests/timestamps tests/soft-delete tests/zod
scripts.bench:jsonb: DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:?DATABASE_URL is required} bun run benchmark/jsonb.ts
